fields.description: Address of the destination as scheme, host and optional port, such as `https://example.com:8443`; the path goes in the base path and endpoint.
fields.label: Host (scheme, host and port)
fields.name: host

fields.description: Path prefix of every request, such as `/proxy/v2` when the destination sits behind a reverse proxy.
fields.label: Base Path
fields.name: base_path

fields.description: Path the events are sent to, after the base path.
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.name: endpoint

fields.description: Path the events are sent to, used instead of the endpoint when the path itself is a credential, as in a webhook URL; the API never returns it.
fields.label: Secret Endpoint
fields.name: secret_endpoint

fields.description: Query parameters added to every request, by parameter name.

entry_fields.description: Values of the query parameter, sent as written; the API returns them.
entry_fields.label: Public Values
entry_fields.name: values

entry_fields.description: Values of the query parameter the API never returns.
entry_fields.label: Secret Values
entry_fields.name: secrets

entry_fields.description: Files whose content, without surrounding whitespace, is a value of the query parameter; read at every request.
entry_fields.label: Secret File Paths
entry_fields.name: files

fields.label: Query Parameters
fields.name: query_params

fields.description: HTTP method of the request that carries each event as a JSON body, in uppercase.
fields.label: HTTP Method
fields.name: method

fields.description: User for HTTP basic authentication, sent with the password.
fields.label: Username (Basic Auth)
fields.name: username

fields.description: Password for HTTP basic authentication.
fields.label: Password (Basic Auth)
fields.name: password

fields.description: Token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
fields.label: Bearer Token
fields.name: bearer_token

fields.description: Extra headers sent with every request, by header name. Names are case-insensitive; headers the HTTP transport owns, such as `Host` or `Content-Length`, are refused.

entry_fields.description: Values of the header, sent as written; the API returns them.
entry_fields.label: Public Values
entry_fields.name: values

entry_fields.description: Values of the header the API never returns.
entry_fields.label: Secret Values
entry_fields.name: secrets

entry_fields.description: Files whose content, without surrounding whitespace, is a value of the header; read at every request.
entry_fields.label: Secret File Paths
entry_fields.name: files

fields.label: Custom HTTP Headers
fields.name: headers

fields.description: Accepts any server certificate. The connection can then be intercepted: use it only for tests.
fields.label: Skip TLS Certificate Verification
fields.name: tls.insecure_skip_verify

fields.description: PEM file with the certificate authorities that sign the server certificate. Empty uses the system trust store.
fields.label: CA Certificate File
fields.name: tls.ca_file

fields.description: PEM client certificate for mutual TLS, set together with the key file.
fields.label: Client Certificate File (mTLS)
fields.name: tls.cert_file

fields.description: PEM private key of the client certificate.
fields.label: Client Key File (mTLS)
fields.name: tls.key_file

fields.description: Name checked against the server certificate when it differs from the host the output connects to.
fields.label: Server Name Override
fields.name: tls.server_name

fields.description: Events below this priority are not sent to this output. Empty sends every priority.
fields.label: Minimum Priority
fields.name: runtime.minimum_priority

fields.description: Events this output holds while they wait for delivery. When the queue is full, new events for this output are dropped and counted as dropped.
fields.label: Queue Size
fields.name: runtime.queue_size

fields.description: Deliveries this output runs at the same time.
fields.label: Worker Count
fields.name: runtime.workers

fields.description: Delivery attempts per event, the first one included. A permanent error, such as rejected credentials, is not retried.
fields.label: Max Retry Attempts
fields.name: runtime.retry.max_attempts

fields.description: Wait before the second attempt, as a duration such as `500ms` or `2s`.
fields.label: Retry Initial Interval
fields.name: runtime.retry.initial_interval

fields.description: Longest wait between two attempts, as a duration.
fields.label: Retry Max Interval
fields.name: runtime.retry.max_interval

fields.description: Factor applied to the wait after each failed attempt, up to the longest wait.
fields.label: Retry Backoff Multiplier
fields.name: runtime.retry.multiplier

fields.description: Consecutive failed deliveries that open the circuit. While it is open the output sends nothing and new events wait in the queue.
fields.label: Circuit Breaker Failure Threshold
fields.name: runtime.circuit_breaker.failure_threshold

fields.description: Successful deliveries in a row that close the circuit again after the reset timeout.
fields.label: Circuit Breaker Success Threshold
fields.name: runtime.circuit_breaker.success_threshold

fields.description: Time the circuit stays open before a trial delivery, as a duration.
fields.label: Circuit Breaker Reset Timeout
fields.name: runtime.circuit_breaker.reset_timeout

fields.description: Checks the destination at startup, on reload and on API changes, for up to 5 seconds. A failure, such as rejected credentials or a missing resource, does not refuse the configuration: the output starts degraded with the reason in its status and delivers once the destination accepts.
fields.label: Probe the destination before starting
fields.name: runtime.health_check
